This is because the Renilla luciferase levels will be dependent on the transfection efficiency of each cell sample.  The reason why this is important is that the Firefly luciferase levels will be dependent on the Renilla luciferase levels, and therefore the normalisation of Firefly luciferase readings will be dependent on the Renilla luciferase levels being identical in all your different cell samples.
